name: Snow Queen (CR 25) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Snow Queen (CR 25) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Snow Queen (CR 15)" but are not part of the Snow Queen (CR 25) entry, which is unchanged.

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +2 icy burst quarterstaff +11/+6 (1d6+2+1d6 cold)
Special Attacks blizzard 1/day (5 rounds, 16 10-foot cubes, 16d4 damage, DC 23), hex (hypothermia, 3 round, DC 21), ice splinter 8/day (1d6+6), mythic power 15/day, surge +1d8
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 16th, concentration +21)

2/day)—summon monster VIII (elder ice elemental)

Oracle Spells Known (CL 12th, concentration +17)

6th Level (3/day)—cold ice strike M (DC 23), cone of coldm My (DC 23), freezing sphere (DC 23), mass cure moderate wounds
5th Level (6/day)—hymn of mercy (DC 20), icy prison M My (DC 22), mass cure light wounds, holy ice (DC 22), sacred nimbus , summon monster VS (ice elementals only)
4th Level (7/day)—alter river, cure critical wounds, death ward, greater positive pulse (DC 19), ice stormm My S, path of glory, restoration

Base Atk +9; CMB +9; CMD 21
Traits House of Green Mothers’ Pupil, Rich Parents
Feats Alertness*, Elemental Focus (cold), Elemental Spell (cold), Extra Revelation, Familiar Bond, Improved Familiar M , Rime Spell, Widen Spell M
Skills Diplomacy +20, Knowledge (nature) +16, Knowledge (nobility) +16, Knowledge (religion) +16, Perform (sing) +17, Survival +15
Languages Aquan, Common
SQ bonded spirit (ancestors, frost, lore, tribe), divine surge (inspired spell), oracle’s curse (reclusive), path abilities (divine metamastery, divine potency, mythic domain, mythic spellcasting x2, overcome curse), revelations (blizzard, child of winter, ice shape 8/day [26 cu. ft.], servant of winter)
Gear cloak of resistance +2 (4,000 gp), crystal tiara (32,400 gp), +3 glamered icelink chainmail (26,800 gp), gloves of personal purity (1,000 gp), oracle’s kit (9 gp), 2 potions of cure serious wounds (1,500 gp), +2 icy burst quarterstaff (32,300 gp), lesser ring of revelation – child of winter (10,000 gp)

ICE ELEMENTAL FAMILIAR, SMALL

Equivalent Wizard Level 12
N Small outsider (air, cold, elemental, extraplanar, water)
